title: Calisthenics beginner-Intermediate
author: Brian T
desc:
Boostcamp never really offered a well-rounded calisthenics program that I found could work without needing to still go to a gym, so I tried to make one for those interested.

This is a 3-day program, it's made for 2 weeks for easier track of progress. You want to start with the base program as is, each alternative is the harder version of what to go next if you manage to complete the full sets and reps with perfect form each time, before you switch to the alternative, for some you want to do a 3 second pause (Pull ups, pushups, etc) before moving to the alternative. The alternatives to pick you go from top to bottom, as that you do not pick the harder one first. For some that are weighted I would recommend a backpack or a vest that you can add weight to. Rest time is for 2 minutes for exceptions of the leg and ab exercises which will be 60-90 seconds. I made this program mostly for myself but thought I would share it anyway, if you have any suggestions for what I could add, leave a review and I will try my best to review. 

(For the timed exercises like hollow holds, it wouldn’t allow me to make it seconds, but know it isn’t a 20-40 minute hold it’s seconds)

To warmup, I would recommend a brisk walk or some jumping jacks, follow it with arm circles and easier versions of the exercises to get flowing, such as normal push-ups, or bodyweight squats, and other types of stretches to follow. 

Make sure to follow with cardio as well, either on your off day or after your strength workout is complete, for myself I do either swimming or biking, but it is up to you. This program if you are at a beginner/novice level, will take a year or two of dedication to complete every ladder, if you do complete it, start trying to find fun stuff to do like muscle ups.
